title: WorkcellState
description: State published by a workcell back to RMF2.0. The state field is validated against the Custom Workcell Type's allowed states. data is open for any device-type-specific telemetry.

state.description: Current state, e.g. idle, busy, error, offline — must be one of the Custom Workcell Type's allowed states

currentRequestId.description: ID of the request currently executing. Omit when idle.

errors.description: Active error codes; empty when healthy

data.description: Optional custom telemetry — open schema, any fields allowed
